additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0471176-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP/S5 170003620] Setting error CRM:02889000989
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0471176.
The ticket was opened for outlet DC2 being out of order by time to time, with LEM error message.
I took a look at the logs and error flags, and I found the issue:
The LEM related error appeared on 2026-01-08T13:05:32 at the end of a session:
As a consequence, the outlet 2 was set as out of order until reboot. The error flag shows the nature of the error reversedVoltage=true
Outlet 2: outoforder, MeterState: Error Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1240230912 status: {"value":81,"bits":{"suLinkStatusIsOk":true,"muFatalErrorOccured":false,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,
"reversedVoltage":true,"
suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":0,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":false,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":false,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}}
I checked the previous tickets on this charger, as per you suggestion, and found that this issue was already addressed in ticket
ID0441323.
This behavior of the LEM DC meter was already addressed by R&D, and solved within
FW v8.1.4.
For this reason, this morning I updated the charger MP/S5 170003620 to FW v8.1.4. The issue of outlets going OoO for LEM error "reversedVoltage" is now solevd.
Since the issue has been identified and the FW including the bugfix has been installed, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

13629 Berlin, Germany

Thank you.
